title: wg: protocol-06 editorial typos in §3.1, §5.1, §5.4
description: Erratum. Directory JSON: update{roomId} missing slash (L1028), "proxyDownload" missing colon (L1042). §3.1 (L372, L379) uses room-policy-03 capability names (canAddUser, canRemoveUser, canSetUserRole) absent from -04, and "permisions". "ExternerSender" (L1654). Broken markup {Section 6.2 of !I-D.ietf-mls-extensions} (L1727-1728). Decisions mimid-1wgh.5.17, .3.28.
notes:
Editor's copy also has §5.5 'groupInfoPublcKey' (typo for groupInfoPublicKey).
Drafting check: canAddUser/canRemoveUser/canSetUserRole appear in neither room-policy-03 nor -04; the 'room-policy-03 names' claim (and decision 3.28's) is unverified; PR says only 'not in -04'.
Also §5.4 notAllowed description says 'accepting the UpdateRequest' (copied from §5.3); should be SubmitMessageRequest. Already fixed in the drafted PR diff on mimid-1wgh.37.40.
Also §5.7 spells both 'requestor' and 'requester'. ('requestContent' -> requestConsent is already in the drafted PR on mimid-1wgh.37.40.)
